verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents version and deploy tracking: it shows which code versions are throwing exceptions and ties errors to releases, so an SRE could roughly compare error activity between a canary version and the prior stable one. The evidence does not show any release-health metrics such as crash-free session or user rates, or adoption per release. Missing for 10: crash-free sessions/users metrics, per-release adoption tracking, an explicit canary-vs-stable comparison view, independent corroboration.
